Shama Institute for Cultural Exchange

Learn languages through real conversations and culture.

Learn the language you've dreamed of, whether it is Arabic, Amharic, Tigrinya, or more, from expert tutors, the majority of whom are refugees. Support dignified livelihoods and join our social enterprise model while gaining fluency and cultural understanding.

Native & Fluent Speakers

Learn from native or highly fluent speakers with real teaching experience and deep cultural knowledge.

Verified Profiles

Every tutor is vetted for quality and commitment to student success.

Flexible Learning

We craft every session around your interests and needs. No rigid curriculum, just real progress.

Affordable Prices

As a mission-driven institute, we focus on quality, not profit. Great education shouldn't cost a fortune.

How it works

Get started in three simple steps

With secure payment up front, we handle the matching so you can focus on learning.

1

Tell us your goals

Fill in a short form with your target language, current level, learning objectives, and availability. It only takes a few minutes.

2

Pay & pick your time

Select a session bundle and complete your payment, then pick the time that works best for you. You'll also have the option to choose your own tutor.

3

Your tutor confirms. You're in!

Your tutor will confirm the appointment. That's it! Enjoy learning.

Why us

Learn a new language online anywhere, anytime!

Ignite cross-cultural connection through the power of language and shared stories.

Learn through real conversations (not textbooks)

Our sessions are built around real dialogue, not drills. You learn by speaking, listening, and connecting with your tutor from day one.

Experience culture, not just vocabulary

Language lives in stories, customs, and shared moments. Our culturally-rich programs help you understand the world behind the words.

Support meaningful global connections

The majority of our staff are refugees and/or women. Your learning journey empowers others by providing them with a decent income.

About us

We empower learners with culturally rich language and storytelling experiences.

Shama Institute combines language instruction with cultural storytelling, pairing you with expert tutors and immersive design to support your bilingual fluency and community connection.

As the first refugee-owned company in Ethiopia, we create paid opportunities for tutors and change-makers while delivering world-class language learning for individuals and organizations.
